data: Saturn orbiter; Huygens landed on Titan
Skeleton entry for /fleet (PRD-012 v0.2 / Phase A scaffold). Builder + agency + first-flight per public sources. Specs and gallery TBD in later phases.

The Saturn orbiter (2004–2017) that carried ESA’s Huygens lander to Titan — still the only landing on a moon of an outer planet. Discovered the active geyser plumes of Enceladus and the global ocean beneath its icy crust. Ended in a planned plunge into Saturn’s atmosphere.
13 years in orbit around Saturn — Huygens landed on Titan 2005-01-14 (first outer-solar-system soft landing)
NASA Discovery polar orbiter — neutron-spectrometer hydrogen finding at both poles 1998; deliberate Shoemaker impact ended mission 1999
Joint BMDO + NASA lunar orbiter — first global multispectral map and first bistatic-radar evidence for polar water ice
Longest-lived Mars asset ever — orbiting since 2001-10-24. Gamma-ray + neutron water-ice maps; UHF relay for the surface fleet
First asteroid sample ever returned to Earth
ESA's first Mars orbiter; Europe's first planetary mission
First European Moon mission — solar-electric ion drive. Spiralled to the Moon over 13 months; deliberate impact 2006-09-03
